note: Small family-owned campground on the owners' homestead beside US-12 south of Baraboo, near Devil's Lake: back-in RV sites around a loop, and tent sites out by a fishing pond (catch and release, no swimming). The amenity list names no showers. Self check-in in daylight; stays of two weeks or more need a seasonal agreement. --Claude
summary: Operator site, terms, Campspot park record and quote, map PDF, Google and imagery read. Posted RV rate $50 (passes the gate exactly; Campspot shows $52.25, and the Wisconsin Dells gateway at 22 km covers it either way). 30A + water, reservations required, nightly campground (seasonal agreement only for 2+ weeks). Google 4.6/91. Not waterfront confirmed. Season not posted.
flags: PRICE GATE: posted RV base rate $50 a night (2 adults + their children under 12), which is not over $50; Campspot's average nightly price is $52.25 for every RV type (tent $31.35 vs posted $30, so a uniform 4.5% on top, read for 2026-11-20 with nothing available; 2027 dates return nothing yet). If the reviewer counts $52.25, the gateway exception applies: audit/price_research/gateways.py finds Wisconsin Dells (attraction) at 22 km. No summer premium is posted; peak = $50 posted / $52.25 Campspot. Google 4.6 over 91 (Campspot 4.6 over 27).

LONG-STAY: a nightly campground - reservations required online for all camping; 'If you are staying in our park for two weeks or longer, we require a seasonal agreement'. No seasonal-lease character on the site; tests pass.

RIG LENGTH: the site says '10ft x 20ft concrete pads' for RV sites, and Campspot has Compact, Small, Regular and Large RV types, but no site lengths were readable (no sites listed for any date read). Imagery shows trailers and motorhomes parked along the loop. Unclear pad size -> keep; reviewer may want a length check.
SITES: the map numbers 41 sites (1A-10B, 11-32); the RV/tent split is not stated, so no count written.
SEASON: not posted; no 2027 dates bookable yet on Campspot; nothing written.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The ~1 ha pond is ~200 m north of the RV loop, next to tent sites 23-24 (the 'Waterfront Tent Site' type); a small creek runs under the tree line west of the loop. Imagery (Esri, 400 m frame).
PIN: 43.4287,-89.7749 is at the loop entrance, about 60 m north of the loop's middle. Fine.
Inclusion evidence describes this campground (rate and Campspot live).
